title: Types of Convenience Foods
author: EJHcv6GrpmCFmfDvc
chapter_outcomes: Understand what convenience foods are, including foods that are partly or totally prepared by manufacturers such as dehydrated, tinned, frozen, ready-to-eat and cook-chill foods.
Understand how convenience foods can be used intelligently as part of a balanced diet.
Understand the advantages and disadvantages of using convenience foods.
Understand the different types of food additives and their functions.
Understand the types of food packaging, materials used, and the advantages and disadvantages of different packaging methods
Understand the information found on food labels and the reasons why food labelling is required.
